scope: Strike Evasive completion and category reconciliation

records.name: Brutal Buster
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 141 - Uub's Ultimate Challenge; random skill drop from Cell when defeated
records.effect: Creates a short-range shockwave around the user. Charging increases power; a fully charged version is unblockable and can break the opponent's guard.

reconciliation.status: The repository research batches now cover the full current 16-entry Strike Evasive category, but Bloody Counter, Evil Flight Strike, and Evil Whirlwind were not created in this batch because they require their own evidence review; they may already exist elsewhere in the repository under different research records and should be searched before adding duplicates.

notes: Dragon Ball Wiki explicitly documents Future Warrior acquisition from PQ141 and describes the random Cell drop. Current DBXV2 Fandom documents Brutal Buster as a 300-Stamina Strike Evasive and lists PQ141. Ultimate Finish requirement remains null because the reviewed sources establish a random drop but do not explicitly establish that the drop requires the Ultimate Finish.
